title: Brother Osk's line 'I wasn't there. Sent off for dry wood on some errand nobody even remembers giving me now' reads as first-person memory of the chapel fire from four hundred years ago, but Osk is introduced as a present-day young novice whose only established grief is his family's recent drowning in Fenmarch — the two griefs blur together confusingly here.
where: The Priory of Ash (Emberfall) / ask what he really remembers of that day
